why: There are three end symbols: circle, square and triangle. Each one moves one step anticlockwise around the five line ends (top-left, bottom-left, stem, bottom-right, top-right). From B, the square goes to bottom-left, the circle goes to the stem and the triangle goes to top-right: option 3. This also leads to D correctly. Option 4 has the triangle at top-right but the circle and square are in the wrong places.
trick: Track one symbol at a time through all the figures; each one follows the same path.
note: Whole row A, B, ?, D drawn as one SVG because D comes after the ?.
